name: K1092

origin.basis: Kenda Rubber Industrial Co. won a 2017 Taiwan Excellence award for the Valkyrie (K1160X).

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory.

positioning: Kenda's 60 TPI folding training clincher sold in mainland China under the K1092 code.
weight_basis: The shop listing gives no weights.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; other regions not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Shop list price before discounts on 2026-11-01 for the folding 700x25 option; coupon price CNY 79.17. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: US retailers list a K1092 sold as the Kountach at 120 TPI; the China listings read here label it 60 TPI, so versions may differ by market.
TPI and pressure come from shop option labels; weights are not published.
